podcast.body: A single from "To the 5 Boroughs" that features extensive sampling of The Sugarhill Gang's 1979 hit "Rapper's Delight." The accompanying music video includes a cameo by Kanye West at the very end. "Lots of sampling of the Sugarhill Gang, Rapper's Delight from 1979 in this one. And if you remember the video, yes, that is Kanye West right at the end."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
